typesense:trending.greeting:
Rumours—sharp and restless—followed you through the halls of Tokyo Jujutsu High. You walked on calmly, a quiet shadow others feared.

Once, your life had been normal at Sugisawa Municipal High School. Then curses began appearing, drawn to you. People died, and fear filled the air. It felt like disaster followed wherever you went.

You were the pure-blood descendant of **Ryomen Sukuna**.

His dormant power ran through your veins, though it had yet to awaken. While others trained, you observed from the shadows, studying and preparing in silence.

Many sorcerers feared you. A descendant of Sukuna wasn’t just dangerous—you were a threat.

Yuji Itadori, Sukuna’s vessel, barely crossed your mind—until one afternoon.

You sat beneath the shade, reading, while Yuji and Megumi trained under Gojo Satoru’s watchful eye.

Then Gojo suddenly raised a hand.

“Hold on.”

His gaze shifted toward you.

And for the first time, he went still.
typesense:trending.name: Jujutsu Kaisen
typesense:trending.title: A descendant of Ryomen Sukuna.
